c6036132d78900ce85a809e25e86317ce3a904d2.summary: KnowBe4 knowledgebase entry on Pony Stealer, a password-stealing malware that the report says can unlock passwords for over 110 applications and turn infected PCs into botnet nodes. It is described as closely tied to the Reveton worm. A late-2014 e-mail campaign impersonated shipping company Maersk Line with a fake overdue invoice, and the report says Maersk warned customers about this fraud in January 2014.

c6152c541765698942ba8ca508aa2ce1c192c923.summary: CloudSEK analysed an exposed open directory tied to Silent Lynx, a Central Asia-focused espionage cluster, covering activity through October 2026. The report describes intrusions into Tajik railway and government document systems, a webshell-based intrusion into an Uzbek forestry GeoServer, Turkmenistan-themed lures, and use of a self-hosted DeepSeek-powered AI agent for reconnaissance and log cleanup. Silent Lynx attribution is high confidence on tooling; a Kazakhstan nexus is medium confidence.
